paragraphs.source_en: At his residence in Uchino, Hideyoshi formally received Tadakatsu. That night, he went in disguise to Tadakatsu's lodgings. Such was Hideyoshi's daring nature. As he spoke of the Battle of Nagakute, he presented Tadakatsu with a Sōshū Sadamune dagger and one of Fujiwara no Teika's Ogura poetry cards. He also gave Amano Saburōbei Yasukage, whom he had not previously favored, a Takagi Sadamune sword, and settled the arrangements for the marriage.

paragraphs.source_en: The party left Okazaki on the morning of the twelfth and spent the night at Yoshida. Only then did Asahi-hime hear that the wedding ceremony had been fixed for the sixteenth.

paragraphs.source_en: “My lady is quite weary, so we shall not travel tomorrow. We will rest here in Yoshida for two days and proceed to Hamamatsu on the fourteenth.” Itō Tango-no-kami, who had grown up with Asahi-hime, came to tell her.

units.source_en: “My lady is quite weary, so we shall not travel tomorrow. We will rest here in Yoshida for two days and proceed to Hamamatsu on the fourteenth.”
units.source_zh: “夫人颇为疲倦，明日就不赶路了，这两日就在吉田歇息，十四日再赴滨松。”

units.source_en: Itō Tango-no-kami, who had grown up with Asahi-hime, came to tell her.
units.source_zh: 从小和朝日姬一起长大的伊藤丹后守来告之。

paragraphs.source_zh: “夫人颇为疲倦，明日就不赶路了，这两日就在吉田歇息，十四日再赴滨松。”从小和朝日姬一起长大的伊藤丹后守来告之。

paragraphs.source_en: “Then has the wedding on the ninth been moved to the fourteenth?” Asahi-hime retorted with displeasure.

units.source_en: “Then has the wedding on the ninth been moved to the fourteenth?”
units.source_zh: “那么，是把九日的婚礼改在十四日了？”

units.source_en: Asahi-hime retorted with displeasure.
units.source_zh: 朝日姬不满地反问。

paragraphs.source_zh: “那么，是把九日的婚礼改在十四日了？”朝日姬不满地反问。

paragraphs.source_en: Asahi-hime suddenly remembered someone entirely unconnected with her—the Lady Nō, Lord Nobunaga's principal wife, who had been ordered to assassinate her bridegroom.

units.source_en: Asahi-hime suddenly remembered someone entirely unconnected with her—the Lady Nō, Lord Nobunaga's principal wife, who had been ordered to assassinate her bridegroom.
units.source_zh: 朝日姬突然想起了完全与自己无关的人——领命前去行刺新郎的信长公正室浓姬。

paragraphs.source_zh: 朝日姬突然想起了完全与自己无关的人——领命前去行刺新郎的信长公正室浓姬。

paragraphs.source_en: Certainly not her late husband, Saji Hyūga-no-kami. He too had hated Hideyoshi, but Hideyoshi was both his lord and his wife's elder brother; powerless to act, he had died bearing his grievance.

units.source_en: Certainly not her late husband, Saji Hyūga-no-kami. He too had hated Hideyoshi, but Hideyoshi was both his lord and his wife's elder brother; powerless to act, he had died bearing his grievance.

paragraphs.source_en: That night, in her bedchamber at Yoshida Castle, Asahi-hime again saw her late husband, Saji Hyūga-no-kami, who had not appeared to her for a long while. The sound of the wind woke her, and she cried out in terror, “Who is there?”

units.source_en: That night, in her bedchamber at Yoshida Castle, Asahi-hime again saw her late husband, Saji Hyūga-no-kami, who had not appeared to her for a long while.
units.source_zh: 朝日姬是夜在吉田城的卧房里又看见了好久未现身的亡夫——佐治日向守。

units.source_en: The sound of the wind woke her, and she cried out in terror, “Who is there?”
units.source_zh: 风声把她吵醒了，她惊恐地问：“谁！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 朝日姬是夜在吉田城的卧房里又看见了好久未现身的亡夫——佐治日向守。风声把她吵醒了，她惊恐地问：“谁！”

paragraphs.source_en: Standing soundlessly before the folding screen was the gaunt Hyūga-no-kami Hidemasa, his hair neatly bound and the lower half of his body stained with blood. He said nothing. Asahi-hime asked why he had come and what he wanted, but he merely stood in silence, gazing steadily at her.

units.source_en: Standing soundlessly before the folding screen was the gaunt Hyūga-no-kami Hidemasa, his hair neatly bound and the lower half of his body stained with blood.
units.source_zh: 毫无声息地站在屏风前面的，是头发扎得整整齐齐、下半身染着鲜血、消瘦的日向守秀正。

units.source_en: He said nothing.
units.source_zh: 他不言不语。

units.source_en: Asahi-hime asked why he had come and what he wanted, but he merely stood in silence, gazing steadily at her.
units.source_zh: 朝日姬问他来做什么、需要什么，他只是默默地站着，一直注视着她。

paragraphs.source_zh: 毫无声息地站在屏风前面的，是头发扎得整整齐齐、下半身染着鲜血、消瘦的日向守秀正。他不言不语。朝日姬问他来做什么、需要什么，他只是默默地站着，一直注视着她。

paragraphs.source_en: “My lady, what is wrong? Are you unwell? My lady!” Itō Tango-no-kami's mother shook her awake, and only then did she start up violently. Hyūga-no-kami had vanished. A faint candle burned in the room, while far off the wind beat against the eaves.

units.source_en: “My lady, what is wrong?
units.source_zh: “小姐，怎么了？

units.source_en: Are you unwell?
units.source_zh: 不舒服吗？

units.source_en: My lady!”
units.source_zh: 小姐！”

units.source_en: Itō Tango-no-kami's mother shook her awake, and only then did she start up violently.
units.source_zh: 伊藤丹后守的母亲摇醒她，她方猛地跳了起来。

units.source_en: Hyūga-no-kami had vanished. A faint candle burned in the room, while far off the wind beat against the eaves.
units.source_zh: 这时日向守已经不见了，屋里亮着微弱的烛光，风远远地拍打着屋檐。

paragraphs.source_zh: “小姐，怎么了？不舒服吗？小姐！”伊藤丹后守的母亲摇醒她，她方猛地跳了起来。这时日向守已经不见了，屋里亮着微弱的烛光，风远远地拍打着屋檐。

paragraphs.source_en: “No, it is nothing!” Asahi-hime said, though she had no wish to return to sleep at once. The shade of Saji Hyūga-no-kami had not meant to command her to assassinate Ieyasu; he had merely stood there in sorrow. Asahi-hime felt that he would appear whenever she wished him to.

units.source_en: “No, it is nothing!”
units.source_zh: “不，没什么！”

units.source_en: Asahi-hime said, though she had no wish to return to sleep at once.
units.source_zh: 朝日姬道，却不想马上睡去。

units.source_en: The shade of Saji Hyūga-no-kami had not meant to command her to assassinate Ieyasu; he had merely stood there in sorrow.

units.source_en: Asahi-hime felt that he would appear whenever she wished him to.
units.source_zh: 朝日姬觉得，只要她想，他便会出现。

paragraphs.source_zh: “不，没什么！”朝日姬道，却不想马上睡去。佐治日向守的阴灵没有令她刺杀家康的意思，只是忧伤地站在那里。朝日姬觉得，只要她想，他便会出现。

paragraphs.source_en: “How heartless you are!” She reproached herself, but dared not speak aloud. From that moment on, the thought of assassinating Ieyasu continually tormented Asahi-hime.

units.source_en: “How heartless you are!”
units.source_zh: “你好薄情啊！”

ja.t: すことはできなかった。

units.source_en: From that moment on, the thought of assassinating Ieyasu continually tormented Asahi-hime.

ja.t: しめられるようになった。

units.source_zh: 从此时开始，朝日姬就一直被刺杀家康这种念头困扰。

paragraphs.source_zh: “你好薄情啊！”她责备着自己，却不敢出声。从此时开始，朝日姬就一直被刺杀家康这种念头困扰。

paragraphs.source_en: They reached Hamamatsu on the fourteenth and spent the night at Sakakibara Yasumasa's residence. Neither that night nor the next could she free herself from the apparition. This time the Saji Hyūga-no-kami she saw not only had blood staining the lower half of his body, but his hair also hung loose and wild. She even saw a vision of herself assassinating Ieyasu in his chamber.

units.source_en: They reached Hamamatsu on the fourteenth and spent the night at Sakakibara Yasumasa's residence.
units.source_zh: 十四日抵达滨松，夜宿神原康政家中。

units.source_en: Neither that night nor the next could she free herself from the apparition.
units.source_zh: 这一夜和接下来的一夜，她都没有摆脱这种幻影。

units.source_en: This time the Saji Hyūga-no-kami she saw not only had blood staining the lower half of his body, but his hair also hung loose and wild. She even saw a vision of herself assassinating Ieyasu in his chamber.

paragraphs.source_en: Even on the day of the wedding, the vision remained lodged in her mind and would not leave her.

units.source_en: Even on the day of the wedding, the vision remained lodged in her mind and would not leave her.

paragraphs.source_en: The sky was overcast but rainless. Asahi-hime alone rode in a palanquin; everyone else proceeded on foot. Clad entirely in white, Asahi-hime sat within the palanquin with her head bowed. The windows on both sides of the palanquin stood open, allowing those beside the road a dim glimpse of her.

units.source_en: The sky was overcast but rainless. Asahi-hime alone rode in a palanquin; everyone else proceeded on foot.

paragraphs.source_en: Solemn-looking warriors stood before the whispering crowds. Every kind of celebration had been prepared inside the castle; even a sarugaku performance was ready. After the wedding, a ceremony would be held for Asahi-hime to adopt Chōshōmaru as her son. Yet some people still openly showed their dislike of Asahi-hime.

paragraphs.source_en: In the inner court of the main castle, people began speculating whether Ieyasu would share his bed with this forty-four-year-old principal wife. For once a woman passed the age of thirty-three, she was already considered to have entered old age.

paragraphs.source_en: I am the Kanpaku's sister. Having agreed to marry into this house, I must never cause trouble for my brother. As such thoughts tumbled through Asahi-hime's mind, the golden screen set at the highest place directly before the great hall gave off a dazzling radiance that made her slightly dizzy. Perhaps it was because she had dreamed of her dead husband night after night and slept poorly these past several days. She swayed and hurriedly caught hold of her maid's hand.
